title: Enterprise Crucible skill manifest
description: The contract for a skill: a user-facing affordance on an Allium component. Lives beside skill.md, evals.feature and cost-profile.json in a skill directory.

identity.description: What the skill does, one sentence.

capability.description: The enterprise capability this skill serves.

context.description: The skill context (must have a placed spec).

component.description: The component (entity) the skill acts on.

surface.description: The surface the skill works behind, if any.

behaviour_rules.description: Allium rule names that govern the skill.
